node.title: Re: non-capture mode sometimes erases previous capture
node.author: Corion
node.doctext:
This has nothing to do with non-capture mode.

The capture variables $1 and so on only hold the value of the last successful pattern match, and I guess the logic of non-capture mode only comes after the logic that resets $1 on a successful match. See [doc://perlvar] for $1, where the behaviour of resetting $1 etc. is discussed.
